posts.title: The Interview Answer That Sounds Too Generic
posts.spokenScript: This is why your interview answer sounds generic. Here is how to sound prepared without sounding scripted. First: Generic answers sound safe, but they are hard to remember. Second: A specific moment proves judgement better than a list of traits. Third: Stopping cleanly is part of confidence. The rule is simple: Use one situation, one decision, one result, then stop. Save this for your next practice interview.
